protocol.name: anchor-public-development-v1
protocol.scope: all fixed 30 development tasks; fresh pairing, no heldout
protocol.intervention: unchanged known-case adapter; no extra semantic correction on completed initial patches
protocol.stop_gate: complete 30 pairs; eligible > 0; net gain >= 2; no new Controls failures; otherwise stop rollout
protocol.comparison: shared fresh first patch; anchor-only vs anchor+certified public feedback in sole resubmission
protocol.retention: public arm retains correction only if Reproduce and Preserve pass; otherwise restores first snapshot
protocol.accounting: actual calls count shared first once plus both new resubmissions; per-arm totals overlap
